overall_design: Distribute the Vendor Security Review scheduling task across the three records already traversed by David's TODO workflow. David's email establishes that the two requested TODO actions cannot be finalized without the security review on May 30; the team-building document specifies Mark Black as a required participant and links the review time to the afternoon; the feedback cell introduces the urgency by requiring a completed review before Mason's score can be reported. Each carrier contributes a distinct necessary piece, creating an immediate need from the source task.
